purpose: Correlation of the unidimensional (single overall-ability) CAT estimate with the 2-skill correctness and scaffolding abilities on the 115-model set.
interpretation: The single overall-ability axis tracks correctness far more strongly (r=0.996 vs correctness, r=-0.662 vs scaffolding). Because the two latent skills are strongly NEGATIVELY correlated (r=-0.70), one composite cannot represent both: it collapses onto the higher-variance correctness dimension and inverts / obscures the scaffolding axis, so scaffolding-strong-but-correctness-weak models are misranked.
